prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic close lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman in a soft home setting.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult Korean-inspired woman with long slightly messy dark hair, natural dewy skin, soft makeup, warm eye contact and a playful smile, wearing an oversized white shirt with secure coverage and opaque shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-to-mid-body framing, seated or leaning slightly forward, one hand near collarbone or holding shirt edge naturally, relaxed shoulders, soft handheld imperfection, no intimate body emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft black mist filter, warm diffused window light, gentle bloom, creamy tones, slight haze and film grain, private but non-sexual home atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical smartphone portrait, eye-level or slightly lower angle, realistic skin and fabric, slight motion blur, cinematic softness.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-realistic 9:16 close-to-mid-body lifestyle portrait of an approved adult Korean-inspired woman with long dark hair, natural dewy skin, soft makeup, and a warm playful smile. She wears an oversized white shirt with secure coverage and opaque shorts, seated or leaning slightly forward with relaxed shoulders; one hand rests naturally near her collarbone or holds the shirt edge without lifting it. Use a soft black mist filter, warm diffused window light, gentle bloom, creamy tones, slight haze, natural film grain, realistic fabric and skin, and an imperfect handheld home-photo feeling.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, unbuttoned shirt, exposed underwear, cleavage, lingerie, seductive pose, nudity, boyfriend POV, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult reference. Preserve face, identity, hair, shirt palette, soft lighting, and close composition; replace identity or wardrobe with equally opaque approved alternatives. Keep typography absent and remove boyfriend-POV framing.
